note: Apple's MacBook Pro event, expected to introduce the first touchscreen Mac, is reported for later today.

front.title: New M6 Macs buck Apple’s second wave of price hikes
front.tldr: Apple's new M6-powered iMac and 14-inch MacBook Pro keep last year's prices unchanged, a rare bit of restraint during a broader round of Apple price rises.

front.title: Entertainment hits $332 billion to become world's second most valuable sector as Netflix, YouTube and Spotify fly
front.tldr: Entertainment overtook the automotive industry to become the world's second-largest business sector, Interbrand found, powered by the growth of Netflix, YouTube and Spotify.

front.title: Jayson Tatum hits a buzzer-beating jumper in OT to give the Celtics a 125-124 win over the Nets
front.tldr: Jayson Tatum sank a buzzer-beating jumper in overtime as the Celtics edged the Nets 125-124, finishing 10 of 20 from the field and 18 of 22 from the free-throw line.

stories.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
stories.tldr: Google DeepMind's Genie 4 world model can maintain a consistent generated scene for up to two minutes, double its predecessor's limit, with steerable real-time interaction and audio.

stories.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
stories.tldr: Rohit Patel is leaving Meta after eight years working on AI evaluation and reinforcement learning to start Ndoc, a venture aiming to challenge Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

stories.title: Game Boy Color on My Conference Badge
stories.tldr: Simon Willison is at GitHub Universe this week, where the conference badge is once again a full colour-screen computer, and he has been hacking around with it.

stories.title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis
stories.tldr: Frontier AI labs say their models have refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis, a long-standing assumption in computer science; TechCrunch asked an MIT researcher to explain what that means.

stories.title: Ford Fathom will be the cheapest American EV capable of powering a house
stories.tldr: Ford is rolling out two new chargers for its upcoming Fathom EV that can power a house or feed electricity back to the grid, so-called vehicle-to-everything capability.

stories.title: GM is embracing hybrids now
stories.tldr: After years favouring battery-electric vehicles over hybrids, GM is reversing course and preparing hybrid versions of its SUVs.

stories.title: The best ways to tell if someone is using AI glasses
stories.tldr: AI smart glasses are common enough now that Engadget has put together tips for spotting a pair on a stranger, useful now the technology is less obvious at a glance.

stories.title: Don't throw away your old Kindle: repurpose it instead
stories.tldr: An old Kindle can still be read on, and with a little effort it can be turned into a useful always-on display instead of being thrown away.

stories.title: Apple Expected to Announce MacBook Pro With Touchscreen Today
stories.tldr: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that Apple will unveil 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models today with touch-enabled OLED screens, thinner bezels, a Dynamic Island and new M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.

stories.title: iOS 27.2 now available: Here's everything new for iPhone
stories.tldr: iOS 27.2 is rolling out to everyone after six weeks of beta testing, bringing a batch of new iPhone features including expanded Siri AI language support.

stories.title: Apple releases two new real-life Apple Watch stories, including a life-saving alert
stories.tldr: Apple's YouTube channel posted two new instalments of its 'True Apple Watch Story' series, including one where the watch's alert helped save a woman's life.

stories.title: Apple Creator Studio adds powerful new AI features and even more creative tools
stories.tldr: Apple is updating Creator Studio, its suite of creative apps, with new AI features and tools aimed at giving creators more studio-grade capability.

stories.title: Oscars will 'always' reward human excellence in the AI era, Academy chiefs say
stories.tldr: Academy president Lynette Howell Taylor told Variety in Tokyo that the Oscars will keep honouring human-driven filmmaking as AI spreads through the industry.

stories.title: Dune: Part Three Reveals First Look At Paul Atreides & Chani's Children
stories.tldr: The final trailer for Dune: Part Three gives a first look at Paul Atreides and Chani's children, who look set to play a crucial role in the story.

stories.title: Brad Pitt's survival thriller has quietly become a sleeper box office hit
stories.tldr: David Ayer's survival thriller Heart of the Beast has quietly turned into a box office hit, proof that Brad Pitt can still draw a crowd.

stories.title: 'You Can See Everything' is a box office hit, but unlikely to beat 'Fahrenheit 9/11' as the highest-grossing documentary ever
stories.tldr: Nathan Fielder's documentary 'You Can See Everything' is a box office hit, though unlikely to match Michael Moore's 'Fahrenheit 9/11' as the highest-grossing documentary ever.

stories.title: Celtics injury report against Nets reveals great health news
stories.tldr: The Celtics will not need to sit Jayson Tatum, Paul George or Mitchell Robinson against the Nets, a rare run of good health for three players who have battled major injuries recently.

stories.title: Payton Pritchard and the Celtics streak to a big win over the Bulls
stories.tldr: Payton Pritchard led the way as the Celtics continued their hot start to the season with a big win over the Bulls.

stories.title: Patriots Power Rankings Week 8: Streak stops, Pats drop
stories.tldr: New England's power rankings slipped after a Week 8 loss to the Bears, a result many pundits had pencilled in as soon as the schedule came out.

stories.title: Game Preview: Patriots at Dolphins | NFL Week 8
stories.tldr: The Patriots travel to Miami to face the Dolphins on Sunday 1 November at 4:15pm ET.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli extends F1 title lead with US GP win Mercedes didn't expect
stories.tldr: Kimi Antonelli extended his championship lead with a win at the United States Grand Prix that Mercedes did not see coming after a poor Friday practice.

stories.title: Max Verstappen admits Red Bull was 'just a little average' in Austin
stories.tldr: Despite finishing on the podium at the United States Grand Prix, Max Verstappen said Red Bull was 'just a little average' all weekend.

stories.title: The mistakes that cost Lewis Hamilton a podium at F1's US GP
stories.tldr: Lewis Hamilton explained how he narrowly missed a podium at the United States Grand Prix, having started fifth and overtaken Isack Hadjar before losing out again.

stories.title: Red Sox Roster Problem or Solution: Kristian Campbell
stories.tldr: Over the Monster asks whether Kristian Campbell is part of the Red Sox's roster problem or part of the solution, as Boston remains stuck finishing behind its rivals.

stories.title: Payton Tolle is keeping busy as MLB correspondent during World Series
stories.tldr: Red Sox prospect Payton Tolle has been doubling as a World Series correspondent this week, joking that he is 'in one piece' after the assignment.

read.why: Today's AI news, from Genie 4 to Apple baking more AI into Creator Studio, makes this question about AI's reach into product work newly relevant.
read.title: How close is AI to replacing product managers?
read.subtitle: Closer than you think

listen.why: A fitting companion to today's Apple hardware news: the design simplicity ethos behind the machines Apple is launching this week.
listen.title: #349 How Steve Jobs Kept Things Simple

listen.why: Another obsessive product engineer, in the same week Apple ships new hardware built on that same fixation with detail.
listen.title: James Dyson, Dyson

listen.why: Netflix is one of the names behind today's front-page story about entertainment overtaking the auto industry, so it's a good day to revisit how it was built.
listen.title: Netflix (Part 1)

finally.title: Apple Music's 404 page features a fully functional iPod simulator
finally.tldr: Apple Music's error page hides a fully working iPod click-wheel simulator, a small touch of craft tucked away where most people will never find it.
